title: $nd\mathbb{Z}$-cluster tilting subcategories of $d$-Nakayama algebras
summary: Jasso-Külshammer introduced the class of $d$-Nakayama algebras as a higher dimensional analogue of Nakayama algebras. In particular, they are endowed with a distinguished $d\mathbb{Z}$-cluster tilting subcategory. In this paper, we investigate which $d$-Nakayama algebras admit an $nd\mathbb{Z}$-cluster tilting subcategory for $n>1$. The radical square zero case is already covered by results on classical Nakayama algebras due to Herschend-Kvamme-Vaso.
